name: vt
description: Cross-platform agent workflows across the whole Git surface — issues, branches, safe commits, and pull requests — plus model-aware Claude orchestration and Codex-assisted review.

interface.longDescription: VT covers the whole Git surface across Codex, ChatGPT Work, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork: turning a sentence or a screenshot into a well-formed issue, triaging the backlog, taking an issue through branch, implementation, and a linked pull request, and creating focused Conventional Commits. It works with GitHub, GitLab, and Gitea by detecting the host from the Git remote. Claude surfaces receive model-role guidance and can load Codex as an external review and testing specialist.
defaultPrompt: Use VT Commit to organize and push my Git changes safely.
Use VT Issue Create to file an issue from what I am about to describe.
Use VT Issue Process to take an issue through to a pull request.
